question: Which team will put a runner on third base first at Fenway on August 6, 2026: Red Sox or White Sox?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Boston Red Sox": Wins if a Boston Red Sox batter or baserunner reaches third base before any Chicago White Sox player reaches third base at any point during the August 6, 2026 game at Fenway Park, as recorded in the official play-by-play or box score.
- "Chicago White Sox": Wins if a Chicago White Sox batter or baserunner reaches third base before any Boston Red Sox player reaches third base at any point during the August 6, 2026 game at Fenway Park, as recorded in the official play-by-play or box score.
- "No result / Postponed": Wins if the August 6, 2026 game at Fenway Park is postponed, suspended, or cancelled before any runner from either team safely reaches third base.

Clarifications:
- "Reaches third base" means any player is recorded as safely occupying third base at any point in a play, including via a hit, walk, error, passed ball, balk, stolen base, or any other means; a batter who hits a home run and rounds third base counts.
- The Red Sox bat in the bottom of the first inning; if the White Sox place a runner on third in the top of the first inning and the Red Sox have not yet batted, the White Sox win. A runner must safely occupy third base. A runner who is thrown out or tagged out while trying to reach third does not count.
